meta.name: bpmn-workflow
meta.description: Generate and maintain BPMN 2.0 diagrams linked to Gherkin scenarios

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Gherkin场景自动生成并维护BPMN流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发中同步业务流程图与测试场景
copy.tagline_en: Generate and maintain BPMN diagrams from Gherkin scenarios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to keep BPMN diagrams in sync with Gherkin scenarios

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据功能描述自动生成 BPMN 2.0 流程图，并关联 Gherkin 场景。它会创建或更新特征文件、建立跟踪清单，并组合成系统级总图。
howto.when: 通常在 Ask 模式（功能探索）完成后触发，用于可视化流程；也适合在记录系统流程给干系人、编写新场景或更新现有特征时使用。

say.text: 为登录功能生成 BPMN 图
say.note: Claude 会创建该功能的特征文件和流程图。

say.text: 给工作区管理添加新场景
say.note: Claude 读取现有文件并更新。
Claude 合并所有特征到一张完整流程图。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can generate BPMN 2.0 diagrams from feature descriptions, link them to Gherkin scenarios, create/update feature files, build traceability manifests, and compose a system-wide workflow diagram.
howto.when_en: Typically triggered after Ask mode (feature exploration) to visualize flows; also used when documenting system processes for stakeholders, or when adding new scenarios to existing features.

say_en.text: Generate a BPMN diagram for login feature
say_en.note: Claude will create feature file and process diagram.

say_en.text: Add a new scenario for workspace management
say_en.note: Claude reads existing files and updates.
Claude merges all features into a single workflow.
